```{r}
day <- read.csv("Bike-Sharing-Dataset/day.csv")

day1 <- day[,c(6,8)]

day1$winter <- as.numeric(day$season == 1)
day1$spring <- as.numeric(day$season == 2)
day1$summer <- as.numeric(day$season == 3)
#Si las 3 son 0 -> season es fall

day1$misty <- as.numeric(day$weathersit == 2)
day1$rain <- as.numeric(day$weathersit == 3 | day$weathersit == 4)
day1$temp <- day$temp * 47 -8
day1$hum <- day$hum *100
day1$windspeed <- day$windspeed * 67
day1$days_since_2011 <- 1:731
day1$cnt <- day$cnt

#hay que escalar también las binarias (según el profesor de las prácticas)
day2 <- day1
day2$holiday <- scale(day1$holiday)
day2$workingday <- scale(day1$workingday)
day2$winter <- scale(day1$winter)
day2$spring <- scale(day1$spring)
day2$summer <- scale(day1$summer)
day2$misty <- scale(day1$misty)
day2$rain <- scale(day1$rain)
day2$temp <- scale(day1$temp)
day2$hum <- scale(day1$hum)
day2$windspeed <- scale(day1$windspeed)
day2$days_since_2011 <- scale(day1$days_since_2011)
modelo1 <- lm(cnt ~ holiday + workingday + winter + spring + summer + misty + rain
             + temp + hum + windspeed + days_since_2011, data = day2)
summary(modelo1)
```
